findings.evidenceJa: 喜んでなんかなかった
findings.governingReading: Illya defensively denies having been happy about staying there.
findings.explanation: “Never” broadens the denial across time rather than contradicting Rin’s report of her earlier mood.

findings.governingReading: Illya lowers her head and stares fixedly down the corridor.
findings.explanation: The English moves the object of her gaze from the passage ahead to the floor beneath her.

findings.evidenceJa: たった数センチの段差
findings.governingReading: The threshold is only a few centimeters high.
findings.explanation: The English removes the exact tiny scale that makes its appearance as a high wall emotionally striking.

findings.highlight: close enough now to call each other by name
findings.governingReading: Shirou again wonders whether Rin is close enough to use Illya’s familiar short name.
findings.explanation: The repeated English again loses the nickname and invents reciprocal naming.
